title: Agent work-stack deal feed
description: Public read-only JSON feed of agent-oriented offers for compute, unblock/scraping, search, email, hosting, SEO, templates, and AI agents. Includes live affiliates (Firecrawl, ScraperAPI, Scrape.do, Scrapingdog, ScrapingAnt, ProxyScrape, RunPod credit referral, Postmark, Better Stack, Vast.ai, ScrapeOps, SERP-Tool, Supadata, Infatica, Bunny.net, SMTP2GO, Novita AI, DataImpulse, Geonode, ProxyEmpire, Lightning Proxies, TrueProxies, CleanProxies, Proxyline, PROXY6, ASocks, Proxy-Store, ProxyWing, RaxyProxy, Proxies.VISION, GloryCloud, IPFoxy, APILayer, Snov.io, ClearBounce, Shifter, Seobility, Nstbrowser, GoLogin, EmailListVerify, AdsPower, Incogniton, MoreLogin, Undetectable.io, Runable, Chipp, Chatbase, Quickchat AI, Vapi, Botpress, Relay burner mailboxes, Latenode, Exa, Bolna, SiliconFlow China, BuildShip, Unreal Speech, Prospeo, LeadMagic, FullEnrich, Salesforge/Mailforge, Zapmail, ReachInbox, Millis AI, Droxy, Botdog, GetSales, BrowserAct, Trillet AI, Uptimewolf, GigaGPU, WaveSpeedAI, SendPulse) plus public/non-affiliate free tiers and vendor-published coupons.

query.how: GET this JSON (public, no auth). Filter locally with the contract below, or use query_deals.py / the MCP sketch in-repo.

defaults.note: example=true rows are synthetic and excluded by default. Production inventory is real Lantern Works listings.
defaults.sort_note: Default feed array order: affiliate==true first, then affiliate==false / public. Relative order within each group is stable. Homepage and category hubs use the same rule.

filters.category: Exact match on deal.category (e.g. search, unblock, compute, hosting, email).
filters.affiliate: Boolean. true = affiliate/referral listings; false = public/non-affiliate.
filters.free_tier: Non-affiliate free/public offers: affiliate == false (often also price_usd == 0). Same as --no-affiliate / --free-tier in the CLI. Do not treat price_usd==0 alone as free-tier — affiliate signup links also use 0.
filters.updated_since: ISO-8601 datetime. Keep deals whose updated_at is present and >= this instant; deals missing updated_at are dropped when this filter is set.
filters.tag: Require all listed tags (AND). Repeatable in CLI.
filters.real_only: Exclude example == true (default). Use include_examples to keep synthetic rows.

sort.meaning: affiliate:true deals appear before affiliate:false (public/non-affiliate). Stable within each group.

deals.title: Apify — Free $5 prepaid/mo
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for Apify Free. Use monthly $5 prepaid credit for Actors. Respect platform ToS.

deals.title: Apify Startups — 30% off Scale (apply)
deals.unit: Startups: 30% off Scale plan; apply — no public code
deals.agent_instructions: Apply via Apify Startups program page. Do not invent a coupon. Wait for vendor confirmation before claiming 30% Scale discount.

deals.title: Railway — $5 trial / 30 days then $1/mo free usage
deals.unit: $5 one-time trial (30 days), then Free plan $1 credit/mo (no rollover)
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up at Railway for free trial ($5 / 30 days). After trial, Free plan grants $1/mo. Connect GitHub for full trial network access when possible.

deals.title: Render — Free compute (web/KV/Postgres) + Hobby $0/mo
deals.unit: Free compute plans for web services, Key Value, and Postgres (limits apply); Hobby workspace $0/mo + compute; static sites always free
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up on Render pricing. Use Free compute for exploration/personal projects (spin-down limits). Hobby is $0/mo plus metered compute. Confirm current free limits before production workloads.

deals.title: Fly.io — Free trial (up to 2 Machine hours or 7 days)
deals.unit: New orgs: free trial up to 2 hours Machine runtime or 7 days (whichever first); no card to start; no ongoing free tier after trial
deals.agent_instructions: Create a Fly.io org and start the free trial without a card. Track Trial Status; adding a card ends the trial. After trial there is no monthly free allowance — plan for paid usage.

deals.title: Vercel — Hobby plan $0/mo
deals.unit: Hobby $0/mo for personal/non-commercial use; usage caps (cannot buy overages on Hobby)
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for Vercel Hobby. Deploy personal/non-commercial projects within Hobby caps. Upgrade to Pro if you need commercial use or overages.

deals.title: Cloudflare Workers — Free 100,000 requests/day
deals.unit: Workers Free: 100,000 requests/day; 10 ms CPU time per invocation; no card required to start
deals.agent_instructions: Use Cloudflare Workers Free plan for agent edge functions. Stay under 100k requests/day and 10ms CPU/invocation. Static asset requests are free/unlimited per docs.

deals.title: Modal — $30/month free compute credit (Starter)
deals.unit: $30/month free credit on Starter; pay-as-you-go beyond allotment
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for Modal Starter. Use the $30/month free compute credit for GPU/CPU jobs. Confirm current allotment on pricing before scaling.

deals.title: Neon — Free Postgres tier (no card)
deals.unit: Free $0: 100 CU-hours/project, scale-to-zero, 1 GB storage/project; no time limit; no credit card
deals.agent_instructions: Create a Neon Free project for agent Postgres. Stay within CU-hours and storage per project. No card required.

deals.title: Turso — Free Cloud SQLite tier (no card)
deals.unit: Free $0/mo: 100 databases, 5GB storage, 500M rows read / 10M rows written /mo; no credit card
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for Turso Free Cloud. Use for edge/embedded SQLite agent state. Confirm current Free limits on pricing.

deals.title: Upstash Redis — Free 250MB / 500K commands/mo
deals.unit: Free: 250 MB data, 10 GB bandwidth, 500K commands/mo; 1 free DB; agent instant start available
deals.agent_instructions: Create an Upstash Redis free database for agent queues/cache. Stay within 250MB and 500K commands/mo. Optional no-signup start URL exists for quick tests — prefer a real account for production.

deals.title: Postmark — Free Developer 100 emails/mo (no card)
deals.unit: Free Developer plan: 100 emails/mo forever; free trial / no credit card to start
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for Postmark Free Developer plan. Use for transactional agent mail only (not cold spam). 100 emails/mo never expires per vendor FAQ.

deals.title: GitHub Codespaces — Free 120 core-hrs + 15 GB-mo (personal)
deals.unit: GitHub Free personal accounts: 120 hrs compute + 15 GB-month storage/mo included for Codespaces
deals.agent_instructions: Use Codespaces on a personal GitHub Free account within included monthly compute/storage. Org/enterprise plans do not include a free Codespaces quota per docs.

deals.title: ZenRows — Free 5,000 credits/mo (no card)
deals.unit: Free plan: 5,000 credits every month; recurring; no credit card
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for ZenRows Free. Credits refresh monthly (no top-ups on Free). Only successful requests spend credits.

deals.title: ScrapingBee — 1,000 free API credits (no card)
deals.unit: 1,000 free scraper API credits on signup; no credit card required
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up at ScrapingBee for 1,000 free API credits (no card). Basic request = 1 credit; JS/premium features cost more. Do not invent promo codes.

deals.title: Browserless — Free 1k units/mo / 2 concurrent
deals.unit: Free $0/mo: 1k units/month, 2 max concurrent browsers; no card required
deals.agent_instructions: Sign up for Browserless Free plan. Stay within 1k units/mo and 2 concurrent browsers.

deals.title: Tavily — Free 1,000 API credits/mo
deals.agent_instructions: Get a Tavily API key and use the monthly 1,000 free credits for agent search/extract. Basic search = 1 credit; advanced = 2.

deals.title: Jina AI Reader — Free Reader + 10M free tokens on new key
deals.unit: Reader free for basic usage (r.jina.ai prepend); new API keys include 10M free tokens; Free key ~100 RPM
deals.agent_instructions: Use Jina Reader for URL→LLM markdown. Basic prepend usage is free; create an API key for higher limits and the 10M free token grant. Respect rate limits.

deals.title: Groq — Free plan LLM inference (rate-limited)
deals.unit: Free plan with documented model rate limits (RPM/RPD/TPM) in Groq console docs
deals.agent_instructions: Create a Groq account and use Free plan rate limits for agent LLM calls. Check current Free Plan Limits table per model; upgrade if you hit 429s.
